title: Text requests got a quieter tune-up
summary:
A week of making the text API and model catalog easier to use, while giving a few inventive community projects room to grow.

Request handling was adjusted for `gpt-4o-mini-search-preview` and Azure Grok. Optional performance tracking records timing, token usage and outcomes without message content, and tracking failures do not interrupt generation. Telemetry also retains complete usage data, including cached-token counts.

`GET /models` no longer returns pricing fields. It groups non-community models before community models and sorts each group alphabetically. The catalog also assigns `openai-fast` (GPT-4.1 Nano) to the anonymous tier and refreshes OpenAI descriptions and provider labels.

The project lists gained two Roblox games built around talking to AI characters, plus @Colin-Zero’s Celebrity AI Image Generator. The directory also picked up corrected links and lost some duplicate entries. Even an escape room needs housekeeping.
